assisted_workflow: Review the extracted draft for OPEN100 sheet 8: one row per item in review_queue_sheet8.csv (88 rows), riskiest first, using the drawing and the overlay SVG in this packet. Fill the OPS_ columns as described in docs/REVIEW_LOOP.md. Draft produced by the declared method M3 (GPT, 2x2 tiles + code line tracing); no re-extraction during the review.
task_definition: Deliverable: every row of the sheet 8 review queue has a decision (confirm, correct with a value, or reject). Rows left blank are reported as unanswered. Items the draft missed entirely are not in the queue; noting them in OPS_notes of the nearest row is allowed and counted separately.
timing_rule: Active minutes only, from timer start to stop with pauses excluded (scripts/review_kit.py timer). Reading these instructions is before start. Breaks and interruptions are paused. The timer is never stopped early in one arm only.
eligible_information_rule: The reviewer sees only the packet files listed in manifest.json (drawing, overlay, queue). The answer key (.graphml) is withheld from the reviewer and used only by the independent auditor.

tasks.truth_reference: PID2Graph OPEN100 8.graphml (symbols and links only; no tag text)

_kit_note: Blank fields are the administrator's decisions (baseline workflow, assignment, rubric, acceptance rule, exclusions, sample size). review_effort.py validate refuses this file until they are filled, frozen and given both arms with different reviewers.
